title: Pilot: harder benchmarks
what: Internal: ten harder benchmarks tried on small fixed subsets, one try per item — step2388 High and Instant against three phone rivals on rented RTX 5090s (21–22 Nov 2026) — and which are worth a full run: the verdicts, the scores, each test's clean runs and cost, the full-run estimate, the blind audit, and the boxes, time and money. Not a row of the board's tables.
